headline: CLE @ TEX matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CLE 3.14 at TEX 3.75, with a projected total of 6.90. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward TEX: CLE moved -0.56 runs while TEX moved +0.12, changing the projected margin by -0.68 runs. The projected total fell -0.44, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Jacob deGrom has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Josh Jung, José Ramírez, Kyle Higashioka, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Stuart Fairchild, Evan Carter because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
